title: Lyndhurst, VA Internet Providers: Lumos Fiber, Xfinity
description: Internet providers in Lyndhurst, VA (22952): Lumos fiber up to 5 Gig, Xfinity cable, 5G home internet and satellite, from FCC data checked November 2026.
lead: Who serves Lyndhurst and the 22952 ZIP code in Augusta County, and what to check before you sign up.
short_answer: Lumos fiber reports the widest coverage in Lyndhurst (22952), with symmetrical plans up to 5 Gig in the FCC data, and Xfinity cable covers most of the area with downloads up to 2 Gbps. Verizon and T-Mobile 5G reach only part of the area. Starlink, Viasat and HughesNet satellite cover the rural roads the wires miss.

sections.h2: Lumos fiber, now part of T-Mobile Fiber
sections.body_html:
Lumos is based in nearby Waynesboro and began a fast fiber build across Waynesboro, Augusta County and Stuarts Draft in 2021-2022. In the June 2026 FCC data it reports fiber across most of the 22952 area, the widest footprint of any provider, at up to 5 Gbps both ways. A small amount of old Lumos DSL (10 Mbps) is still reported.

In April 2025 T-Mobile and the investment firm EQT closed a joint venture to buy Lumos, and T-Mobile said many Lumos customers will become T-Mobile Fiber customers. Lumos's Lyndhurst page still uses the Lumos name and advertises fiber "as little as $40 per month" with equal upload and download speeds. T-Mobile Fiber's national plans page lists no data caps, no annual contract, included installation and a router, but its prices are not specific to Lyndhurst, so confirm the price at your address.

Xfinity reports cable across most of the area, with downloads up to 2 Gbps and uploads up to 250 Mbps. Xfinity's Lyndhurst page on November 25, 2026 listed 300 Mbps at $45 a month with a 5-year price guarantee (everyday price $75) and 500 Mbps at $60 (everyday $85), for new customers using autopay from a bank account and paperless billing, or $10 a month more. The offer was dated to end November 30. Unlimited data and WiFi equipment are included; installation, taxes and fees are extra.

sections.h2: Every provider reporting service in Lyndhurst (22952)

sections.body_html: Source: FCC Broadband Data Collection, June 30, 2026, matched to ZIP codes by YourBillCheck. Footprint compares each provider's reported locations with the widest land-based (wired or fixed wireless) provider near that ZIP code, so it is a guide, not a promise for your street.

sections.h2: If you live outside the fiber and cable lines
sections.body_html: Lyndhurst is rural once you leave the main roads. Verizon 5G home internet (up to 300 Mbps) and T-Mobile (up to 25 Mbps here) each reach only part of the area in the FCC data. Starlink reports up to 280 Mbps anywhere with a clear view of the sky, which makes it the usual fallback; Viasat and HughesNet are slower. Augusta County says it does not own a network or sell service, but it backs state VATI grant projects and an All Points Broadband fiber project with pre-registration, so check the county broadband page if no wired provider reaches your home.
